subject: Spec review 1 done: FAIL, 8 blocking
body: Ran /sc:spec-panel-diffgate review 1 (critique, requirements+architecture) on the worker-contract spec and wrote the full panel result, a 12-item numbered findings list, a guard boundary table and the machine-readable findings block to review/spec-panel.md; diffgate check --dry-run accepts it with verdict FAIL. The section 1 architecture decision holds, but 8 blocking findings remain, mainly that the WC-4 report contract is not implementable as written (status vocabulary clashes with existing success values, workflow bans --output, adversarial path differs), --unattended is accepted on gated commands before their phase (auggie-review would still post), WC-10 conflicts with WC-7 on Agent-tool waves, and WC-7/7.2 never require the Skill call. Left for the coordinator: run the writing diffgate check step to append close-r1.md and the verdict line, then the Task 6 revision; the spec was not edited.
